svg.title: How a citation travels
svg.desc: How a citation travels, and three things that are not the same. The record: a source saved in a citation manager such as Zotero, with its author, title, and year. The citation key: a short, stable name for that source, here lamport1994, pinned with Better BibTeX and exported with the entry into references.bib; you can also paste an entry into references.bib by hand. In a chapter you write only the key, as \parencite{lamport1994}; the keys must match. When you compile, Biber matches the key and formats the citation in your chosen style: [1] in the text, and the full entry under REFERENCES in your PDF. The record, the key, and the formatted citation are different things, and only the key goes in your chapter.
svg.text: the formatted citation, in your PDF

g.text: Only the key goes in your chapter.
